verdict.rationale: Gitea ships its own automation engine, Gitea Actions. It is a GitHub-Actions-compatible CI/CD system where users write YAML workflows that run on an official action runner, with autoscaling runners offered. That covers background automation in substance, but the evidence only describes it as CI/CD and never documents triggers, schedules or autonomous agent-style runs. missing for 10: documented event/cron triggers for unattended recurring runs, any AI/agentic automation features, depth on runner execution and monitoring, independent hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.
We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
